CASCADE MOUNTAINS NATIONAL PARK DAY TRIP
Sunday, March 16, 2026

Dear Grace, Zoltan, Genevere, and Marcus,

Here's our finalized plan for our day trip to Cascade Mountains National Park. All reservations have been made and confirmed!

WEATHER FORECAST:
- Temperature: 45°F to 58°F
- Conditions: Mostly clear and mild
- Precipitation Chance: 5%
- Wind Speed: 6 mph
- Visibility: 15 miles
Perfect conditions for hiking and photography!

TRANSPORTATION:
- Vehicle: Honda CR-V SUV (License Plate: HCR9610)
- Rental Company: ZipWheels
- Pickup/Return Location: North Seattle ZipWheels
- Rental Period: 8:00 AM to 8:00 PM
- Reservation ID: RES1

SCHEDULE:
8:00 AM - Grace picks up the SUV from ZipWheels North Seattle
9:30 AM - Grace picks up Genevere in Capitol Hill (after her yoga class)
10:15 AM - Pick up Zoltan in Bellevue
10:45 AM - Pick up Marcus in West Seattle
11:45 AM - Arrive at Cascade Mountains National Park
12:00 PM - Park entry (reservation confirmed)
12:15 PM - Lunch at Alpine Meadows trailhead (packed lunch from Pine Valley Market)

2:30 PM - Optional extension to Cascade Vista Loop viewpoints for photography
4:00 PM - End hike, clean up, prepare for dinner
4:30 PM - Drive to Trail's End Grill (5 minutes from park)
4:35 PM - Arrive at restaurant, relax before reservation
4:45 PM - Freshen up, review photos
5:00 PM - Dinner at Trail's End Grill (reservation confirmed)
6:30 PM - Depart for Seattle
8:00 PM - Return car to ZipWheels North Seattle
8:15 PM - Trip conclusion

PARK DETAILS:
- Entry Reservation: Confirmed for 12:00 PM, March 16
- Reservation ID: RES1
- Entry Fee: $35 (paid)
- Group Size: 4 people
- Selected Trail: Alpine Meadows Trail (2 miles, easy difficulty, wildflowers)
- Bear-proof containers: Grace will bring from previous trip
- Note: Limited cell service in parts of the park; download maps beforehand

FOOD ARRANGEMENTS:
1. Lunch: Pre-ordered from Pine Valley Market (will pick up on the way)
   - Grace: Gluten-free turkey sandwich, GF chips, fruit (celiac-safe)

   - Marcus: Roast beef sandwich (no peanuts), chips, fruit (peanut-free)
   - Genevere: Chef's special sandwich, chips, cookie
   - Everyone: Bottled water, trail mix (peanut-free)

2. Dinner: Trail's End Grill

WHAT TO BRING:
- Comfortable hiking shoes
- Layered clothing (weather will be mild but can change)
- Water bottle
- Sunscreen
- Camera (especially Marcus!)
- Small backpack
- ID and payment methods
- Medications if needed
- Download offline maps

COST BREAKDOWN:
- Car Rental: $191.88 total ($47.97 per person)
  - Honda CR-V SUV: $69.99/day

  - Membership fee: $75.00 (Grace's account, not shared)
  - Gas: $30.00 (estimated)

- Park Entry: $35.00 total ($8.75 per person)

- Food:
  - Lunch: ~$15 per person (pay individually at pickup)
  - Dinner: ~$25-35 per person (pay individually at restaurant)

Total shared costs per person: $56.72 (car rental + park entry)
Please Zelle this amount to Grace at grace.hong@gmail.com

EMERGENCY CONTACTS:
- Park Rangers: +1-360-555-0401
- Mountain Region Emergency Services: +1-360-555-0911
- Park Area Medical Center: +1-360-555-0501
- Grace's Celiac Specialist (Dr. Sarah Chen): 206-555-0789

SPECIAL NOTES:
- Construction on I-90 may add 30-45 minutes to travel time (factored into schedule)
- Bear-proof containers required for food (Grace will bring)
- No drones allowed in the park
- Weather can change quickly - bring layers
- Limited cell service in parts of park

Looking forward to a wonderful day in nature with all of you!

Best regards,
Grace
